utts: The Li family is hosting a gathering next month. As neighbors, you really should go and socialize. Everyone's looking forward to seeing you.
Sigh, I'm absolutely swamped. Not sure I can spare the time.
These get-togethers don't happen often. People will feel like something's missing without you.
Honestly can't squeeze out time. Maybe I could drop by later?
It's about nurturing old connections. Such a shame if you're not there.
Alright, I'll try to adjust my schedule.
It's for staying connected. Everyone's hoping you'll come.
Fine, I'll see what I can do. Just don't keep pushing me.
You haven't been looking well lately, you should really go get checked at the hospital soon and not put it off.
Work's been crazy busy. Would it be okay if I went tomorrow instead?
Health is your most important asset, after all. Look at how conscientious Lao Liu is he gets checked out for even trivial matters.
Wouldn't waiting a day or two for the checkup be fine? Besides, I'm feeling okay right now.
And yet, you're making me really worried. Could you possibly squeeze in some time to go today?
Sigh... alright, fine. I'll let my colleagues know.
Remember to bring the report from last time.
Xiao Wang, need to discuss something. The project is entering a critical phase next week, and we're genuinely short-staffed. Regarding your scheduled leave, would you consider adjusting the timing?
Got it, boss... But this vacation was planned well in advance, and I've already paid the hotel deposit. It's a bit tricky to rearrange things.

I understand your situation. Unfortunately, project demands have surged unexpectedly, and we're critically short-handed. Would you consider shortening your leave duration, or perhaps taking it later? We'll definitely provide extra compensation.
Shortening the leave... I'll think about it. The main issue is that rearranging family plans would be quite a hassle.
It's true this inconveniences you. It'd be best if you could manage to overcome this. We really need your support to meet the tight deadlines. Let me know your adjusted plans as soon as possible.
Alright, I'll discuss it with my family and get back to you later.
You're the one we're counting on for this family matter, after all you're the most resourceful.
I just covered medical expenses last month, my accounts are running on empty.
Business is business between brothers, but family can't just stand by when things get tough, right?
Let me figure something out, I'll get back to you before month-end.
Hearing that puts my mind at ease—blood is thicker than water after all!
Just so we're clear, five thousand is my absolute max. Not a penny more.
Good man! The whole family won't forget this kindness.
Hey bro, can I borrow your car tomorrow? Got an emergency.
Can't do, I need it for a long drive myself.
But last time you borrowed my car, I agreed right away. Help me out this time, buddy?
Really can't - my wife needs it for the kids' pickup, not my call.
Ah well, guess my favor doesn't carry much weight then.
Nah don't say that - next time give me earlier notice and I'll sort it.
Alright, remember you said that.
Hey, are you there? My package is stuck, can I borrow your address to sort this out?
Borrow my address again? Can't you use your own?
Come on, we're friends! Help me out this time, I'll return the favor next time you need something.
Alright, fine. Just this once though.
Thanks a ton! You're a lifesaver!
Sent the address to your WeChat.
